text:
deploy-bot: Starting regional sweep now — US -> EU -> APAC. Canary: US 5% (v2.0.1-canary). 2m hold. Ping if any capacity/thermal issues. /deploy id: 972343

Dina: Watching US SLOs, warming reserved pool. good to proceed :thumbsup:

Marta: heads up — APAC will need fallback pin to v2.0.0 if latency > 1.5x. please don't auto-shift traffic without pin.

Kevin: Dedicated pool free for APAC 4 GPUs. I can pin if ops SIG ok.

SRE-Oncall: kicking EU thermal check, running smoke tests now.

deploy-bot: Canary started — `deploy start --region us --percent 5 --version v2.0.1-canary` ; id=972343

Sam: US p95 spiked ~20% but within threshold. no errors. :eyes:

SRE-Oncall: EU thermal looks clean. queue depth +8% but latency stable.

Kevin: ops SIG approves pin. pinning APAC to v2.0.0 for safe fallback: `ops pin --region apac --version v2.0.0 --ttl 15m` :white_check_mark:

Marta: thanks — updating release notes and ops-runbook.

deploy-bot: after hold: increasing US -> 25% and starting EU canary 5% (same version)

Dina: confirmed token cost per req steady. safe to ramp US.

deploy-bot: EU canary started — `deploy start --region eu --percent 5 --version v2.0.1-canary`

Sam: quick note: rollback criteria reminder: error rate >3x baseline OR p95 >2x baseline sustained 90s -> trigger rollback to v2.0.0 and alert oncall.

Marta: APAC schedule: warm pools then staggered 1% increments with 30s holds to limit thermal shock.

deploy-bot: EU -> 25% after hold, US/EU at target. APAC remains pinned and in warmup per ops. closing thread unless anyone flags issues.

Kevin: leaving pins and rollback hooks in place. ping me if we need immediate reversion.

SRE-Oncall: all green from SRE. monitors bumped to 30s sampling for next 10m.

Dina: thanks team. I'll post final deploy note in releases channel and attach perf snapshot.

deploy-bot: Rollout: US & EU successful; APAC pinned and warming. thread closed.
